claude.performance_metric: FY2021 net income $56.9M ($26.0M to common) but consecutive Q3/Q4 2021 net losses to common of $43.9M and $27.3M; total assets grew to $13.77B
claude.rationale: No product/process-interface disruption is documented; the volatility described (2020's $174.0M COVID-driven decline in net income from fair-value losses on CRT investments, and the Q3/Q4 2021 net losses to common) is attributed to credit-market and pandemic macro conditions, not to any inability to align an acquired product with operating processes — so p4=0. On the process/organization interface, the slice documents continuity rather than fracture: the registrant remained externally managed by PCM and serviced by PLS (both PFSI affiliates) throughout the window with one employee at year-end 2021, and no operational-vs-organizational breakdown is reported — so p5=0.
